en.title: Nathan Fielder's Elizabeth Holmes Doc Finally Gets UK Release Date
en.summary: The highly anticipated documentary 'You Can See Everything,' chronicling the final days of Theranos founder Elizabeth Holmes before her prison sentence, is set for a UK and Ireland cinematic debut. This A24 release offers a unique, intimate glimpse into a figure who once promised to revolutionize healthcare.
en.body:
The strange and compelling journey of **Elizabeth Holmes**, the disgraced founder of Theranos, is about to get a UK and Ireland release. **Nathan Fielder** and **Lance Oppenheim**’s documentary, titled **‘You Can See Everything’**, will land in cinemas on November 16, 2026. This highly anticipated film provides an intimate look at Holmes in the crucial month leading up to her 11-year prison sentence for defrauding investors, a sentence she began serving after the film’s production wrapped.

The documentary premiered earlier this year at the Telluride Film Festival on September 6, 2026, quickly garnering attention for its unique premise. Thirty-four days before she reported to prison, Holmes invited a film crew, including Fielder and Oppenheim, to document her every move. What was intended as a portrait of an enigmatic figure facing the consequences of her actions evolved into a three-year deep dive, promising a mind-bending exploration of her world.

## Inside the Holmes Enigma

The film’s synopsis hints at a narrative that goes beyond a simple recounting of Holmes's downfall. It suggests an intimate portrait that morphs into something more profound and perhaps unsettling, as the filmmakers delve into the abyss of her experience. With **A24** distributing the film, known for its critically acclaimed and often boundary-pushing cinema, audiences can expect a thoughtful and potentially challenging viewing experience. The documentary promises to unpack the complex layers of Holmes’s persona, moving beyond the headlines to explore the personal reality of a woman at the center of one of the biggest corporate frauds in recent history.

## A Unique Perspective on a Notorious Figure

For fans of true crime, documentaries, and perhaps even Fielder’s signature blend of awkwardness and insightful observation, **‘You Can See Everything’** represents a must-watch event. The opportunity to see Holmes in her own words and environment during such a pivotal moment is rare. It’s a chance to witness the human element behind the Silicon Valley myth, stripped bare as legal repercussions loomed. The film’s release in the UK and Ireland allows a global audience to engage with this captivating story, prompting discussions about ambition, deception, and the cult of personality in the tech world.

## What's Next

**‘You Can See Everything’** is scheduled for a theatrical release in the U.K. and Ireland on November 16, 2026, following its earlier festival premiere and initial US release on October 16, 2026. Keep an eye out for further details on wider streaming availability.
